workflow.title: From WashAndGo to Mac: rethink cleaning intensity

washandgoAdvantages: Documented Windows cleaning presets, optional backup and full-version automatic scheduling (W04/W05); choose it for that Windows workflow rather than pretending Breathing Room runs there.
A documented 30-day test version lets readers inspect fit subject to prompts and no automatic cleaning (W05); this worker did not download/run the installer.
washandgoTradeoffs: Current official Mac offering not verified despite directory tag (W02); licence/tax/seat details unknown.
Marketing safety, 8x findings and speed claims have not been independently verified. Optional backup is not evidence every change can be recovered.
breathingRoomAdvantages: For a Mac user, documented storage views, grouped process observations and explicit cleanup-plan details provide a different investigation workflow (B01/B03); not measured superiority.
Free local app plus separately advertised optional AI Care (B01/B04); not a cross-currency cheaper claim.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Non-notarized testing preview, separate Python prerequisite and untested physical-Intel/clean-machine behavior (B02).
Hosted authenticated assistance can send relevant paths/tool context; scheduled care requires the app running; optional automatic Ruff mode qualifies blanket approval promises (B03/B04).
Do not claim verified duplicate-removal, Windows coverage or feature parity with WashAndGo.
